title: Clustered Vesicular Shingles Lesions (Thigh Dermatome)
author: Rosser1954
caption: Close-up clinical photograph of grouped erythematous vesicles and papules caused by varicella-zoster virus reactivation.
alt_text: Close-up of clustered red papules and fluid-filled vesicles of shingles on human skin.
clinical_relevance: Illustrates vesicular lesion morphology used for clinical recognition and antiviral initiation (valacyclovir) in CLIFF-043 (p.5-7).
